welcome.title: Welcome to Sudoku!
welcome.content: Fill in the 9×9 grid so that each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the numbers 1-9, each appearing only once.

selectCell.title: Select a Cell
selectCell.content: Click on any empty cell to select it. The selected cell will be highlighted.

enterNumber.title: Enter a Number
enterNumber.content: Use the number pad below to enter a number into the selected cell. Press ✕ to erase.

notes.title: Notes
notes.content: Enable notes mode (✏️) to mark possible numbers in a cell. Useful for reasoning!

hints.title: Use Hints
hints.content: Stuck? Use the Hint button for guidance! You have 3 hints per game. Hints will explain step by step.

undo.title: Undo
undo.content: Made a mistake? Press Undo to go back to the previous step. You can undo multiple times!

mistakes.title: Watch Your Mistakes
mistakes.content: You can only make 3 mistakes. The mistake counter shows your current error count.

ready.title: Ready to Play!
ready.content: You're all set! Start by finding cells with only one possible number. Good luck!
